title: Whispers in the Rain
lyrics:
I woke up to a golden light,
The morning kissed the endless night,
Dreams that drift on open seas,
Whispers carried by the breeze.
The road is long, the sky so wide,
A thousand miles, no place to hide,
But in the winds, I hear the call,
Telling me I'll rise if I fall.
So I'm chasing the sky, reaching so high,
Running with the wind, letting go of the why.
With my heart in the clouds, I know I'll find,
The place where my dreams and the stars are aligned.
The shadows fade as I press on,
The darkest night gives way to dawn.
Every step, a beating drumLeading me to where I’m from.
Through the storm and through the rain,
I’ll keep moving past the pain.
In every tear, a light will shine,
I know the road ahead is mine.

title: Starlight Serenade
lyrics:
Underneath the starlight,
 we fade into the night.
 Your heart is my guide,
 leading me to flight.

title: Chasing the Horizon
lyrics:
We're chasing the horizon,
 no limits in our view.
 Through the clouds and over mountains,
 we find something new.

title: Echoes of Tomorrow
lyrics:
Echoes of tomorrow,
 reflections of today.
 In the space between,
 we find a better way.

title: Silent Waves
lyrics:
Silent waves crash gently,
 secrets on the shore.
 The ocean's voice is calling,
 asking us for more.

title: Flicker of Fireflies
lyrics:
Like a flicker of fireflies,
 we dance beneath the skies.
 Every step a heartbeat,
 love never dies.

title: Through the City Lights
lyrics:
Through the city lights,
 I see your face.
 Every turn,
 every street,
 reminds me of our place.

title: Winds of Yesterday
lyrics:
Winds of yesterday,
 they carry our lost dreams.
 Blowing through the memories,
 tearing at the seams.

title: Heartbeat in the Wild
lyrics:
A heartbeat in the wild,
 untamed and free.
 Through the trees and valleys,
 it's calling you and me.

title: Crimson Skies
lyrics:
Under crimson skies,
 the sun begins to fall.
 We stand together,
 rising above it all.
